client_alerts.headline: Meta Muse for Small Business connects to QuickBooks, Stripe, Shopify, Box and Notion
client_alerts.body: Launched Sept 29, Meta's Muse agent now reads across a small firm's finance, sales and document systems. Any SMB client piloting it is granting a consumer-first AI vendor cross-app access to financial and customer data; Meta says the agent won't post, message or buy without approval, but **data handling and retention terms need review before connectors are enabled**.

client_alerts.headline: White House voluntary AI accord + America.gov on Gemini and Grok
client_alerts.body: Top AI vendors signed a self-policing agreement Sept 29 (internal controls, outside auditors, review boards), and a new federal services front door runs on Gemini and Grok. Public-sector and regulated clients should expect vendor attestations referencing the accord; it is **voluntary, not a compliance standard** — don't let it substitute for ISO 42001 / NIST AI RMF evidence.

top_moves.title: Meta takes Muse into business with a small-business agent wired into 12+ SaaS apps
top_moves.body: Muse for Small Business links to Shopify, Stripe, QuickBooks, Asana, Box, Notion, Zoom and more at the same free/$20/$100 pricing. It is Meta's first real enterprise-facing push and a new shadow-AI vector for SMB clients.

top_moves.title: White House AI self-regulation accord signed; America.gov launches on Gemini and Grok
top_moves.body: Vendors commit to internal controls, outside audits and review boards under a morally-binding (not legal) accord, and an oversight adviser is due within days. Expect it to show up in vendor security questionnaires.

top_moves.title: Mistral retires Leanstral 1.5 today; GitHub Copilot model cutoff Oct 19
top_moves.body: Two model retirements land in the next three weeks. Any client workflow pinned to a retiring model ID fails closed — a live example of why model dependencies belong in the BIA.

providers.name: OpenAI
providers.headline: DevDay follow-through: plug-in extensions get a ChatGPT sidebar home, plus Pages, Slides and Spaces; run-rate nears $70B.
providers.detail: TechCrunch detailed the plug-in extensions (app-like UIs and automations inside ChatGPT) announced at DevDay, alongside Dots always-on agents in ChatGPT, Slack and Teams. New Pages/Slides/Spaces features put ChatGPT directly against M365 and Gamma for document work. Revenue run-rate is reported near $70B with B2B more than doubling in Q3.

providers.name: Anthropic
providers.headline: Sonnet 5.5 settles in as the default GA model; IPO prospectus reveals $518B decade-long infrastructure plan.
providers.detail: Sonnet 5.5 (Sept 28) is 30%+ faster than Sonnet 5 at the same $2/$10 price, and cache diagnostics left beta. A confidential IPO filing reportedly commits at least $518B over ten years with Google, Amazon, Microsoft, Broadcom and others — a vendor-viability signal for long-term client standardisation.

providers.name: Google Gemini
providers.headline: Gemini now powers America.gov, the new federal AI services front door; no new model today.
providers.detail: No model ship; Gemini 3.8 Live/Flash and Omni Flash GA remain current. The federal America.gov portal launched on Gemini (with Grok), a notable public-sector trust signal for clients evaluating Gemini under FedRAMP-style constraints.

providers.name: xAI
providers.headline: Grok co-powers America.gov; Grok 4.7 (Sept 21) remains current, with 4.8 and 4.9 slated before Grok 5.
providers.detail: No new model since Grok 4.7. The federal America.gov placement is a surprise legitimacy boost. Grok 4.7 Fast remains exclusive to Cursor and Grok Build, keeping the Cursor-xAI single-vendor risk ahead of the Nov 12 OpenAI cutoff.

providers.name: Meta
providers.headline: Muse for Small Business launches with Shopify, Stripe, QuickBooks, Notion and Box connectors.
providers.detail: Meta's Muse agent now plugs into a small business's sales, finance and ops stack with approval gates on posting, messaging and purchases. Same pricing as consumer Muse (free, $20, $100 tiers). The closed-weight Muse Spark 1.3 still powers it.
providers.alertReason: Cross-app access to SMB financial and customer data

providers.name: Mistral
providers.headline: Leanstral 1.5 retires today; otherwise quiet after Agentic Search and the Mistral Work migration.
providers.detail: No new release. Leanstral 1.5 hits its Sept 30 retirement; the phased Le Chat to Mistral Work account migration continues. Medium 3.5 / Small 4 / Large 3 remain the lineup.

providers.name: Perplexity
providers.headline: Computer adds Effort Mode (Light to Ultra) and GPT-6 Astra; HP will pre-install Perplexity on Windows PCs from October.
providers.detail: Effort Mode lets users set depth while Perplexity picks model and reasoning level. Portable Computer runs locally on AMD Ryzen AI Max, avoiding credits. HP pre-install starting with the ZBook Ultra G3a means Perplexity will appear on client endpoints without a procurement decision.

providers.name: Microsoft 365 Copilot
providers.headline: Copilot Cowork model picker splits into GPT and Claude sections as GPT-6 Astra joins; nine partner plugins added.
providers.detail: The model picker moved into the prompt box with separate GPT and Claude sections; GPT-6 Astra is now in Cowork and Copilot Studio. Excel personalization, workbook rules and Plan with Copilot are GA; nine plugins (Harvey, LSEG, Moody's, Morningstar and others) landed.

providers.name: GitHub Copilot
providers.headline: Copilot CLI v1.0.89 reads Claude Code rule files; Sonnet 5.5 GA; model deprecations cut off Oct 19.
providers.detail: CLI v1.0.89 (Sept 28) adds Claude Code rule-file support and form-input clicking, easing mixed-agent repos. Sonnet 5.5 is GA in Copilot. Copilot Pro stays at $10 vs $20 elsewhere.

providers.name: Cursor
providers.headline: No new ship; still the only public home for Grok 4.7 Fast, with the OpenAI cutoff six weeks out.
providers.detail: No Cursor release today. Claude Code took #1 in LogRocket's September power rankings. The Nov 12 OpenAI model cutoff remains the key planning date for Cursor users.

providers.name: Gamma
providers.headline: Still quiet — no update since the June Gamma Agent/3.0 launch, as ChatGPT Slides encroaches.
providers.detail: No Gamma release found. OpenAI's new Slides and Pages features are the most direct competitive threat to Gamma's deck workflow yet.

providers.name: Notion AI
providers.headline: No new ship; now a named Muse for Small Business connector, with Notion 3.7 skills (Sept 15) the latest release.
providers.detail: No new Notion release. Notion is among Meta Muse's launch integrations, so Notion workspaces become readable by another vendor's agent when owners connect it. Portable skills (exportable to Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini, Grok) remain the headline feature.

persistent_signals.text: Microsoft 365 Copilot — Copilot Cowork commercialisation (billing, cost visibility, skills, model picker) — 2 weeks running
xAI — Grok 4.7 as current state, with Cursor-exclusive Fast variant — 2 weeks running
Notion AI — Notion 3.7 agent skills as latest state — 2 weeks running
Mistral — quiet, OCR/Agentic Search latest, Leanstral 1.5 retirement — 2 weeks running (retirement lands today)

month_themes.then: Session-token security incident at Anthropic; Cursor losing OpenAI access after the SpaceX deal; the agentic-AI DR readiness gap
month_themes.now: Agents moving into business systems (Muse for SMB, Dots, Cowork); voluntary government-vendor AI accords; model retirements as a continuity risk

habits.shift: Make Sonnet 5.5 the default drafter — same price, 30% faster than Sonnet 5; reserve Opus 5.5 for final review passes.
Add a line in every summary distinguishing the voluntary White House accord from certifiable ISO 42001 / NIST AI RMF evidence.
Try Effort Mode High for vendor due diligence instead of manually choosing models; use Ultra only for multi-source comparisons.
Add a model-retirement dependency clause: name the model IDs a deliverable relies on and who owns migration when they sunset.
Keep Gamma for now; trial ChatGPT Slides on one internal deck this week before switching anything client-facing.
No change — Gemini Live remains the best real-time voice option for rehearsal walkthroughs.

habits.task: Client advisory on AI data risk
habits.shift: Add agent-connector reviews (Meta Muse, ChatGPT Dots, Copilot Cowork) to the AI data-risk checklist: which systems, what scopes, who approved.

community.signal: Top-of-week discussion of Nathan Lambert's Congressional testimony: Chinese open-weight downloads now 2x US and 80%+ of OpenRouter open-model usage.
community.so_what: Clients with sovereignty rules who run local models are likely on Chinese weights; add model provenance to the AI asset inventory.

community.signal: Popular build threads running Qwen3.8-27B heavily quantised on llama.cpp behind an OpenAI-compatible API.
community.so_what: A viable offline fallback for AI-dependent workflows during a cloud-provider outage — worth a DR tabletop scenario.

community.signal: Heavy discussion of DevDay's Dots agents and plug-in extensions, alongside the Sora API shutdown (Sept 24).
community.so_what: The Sora API shutdown is a fresh example of a vendor killing an API with little notice; cite it in exit-strategy conversations.

watch.title: GitHub Copilot model deprecation — Oct 19
watch.body: Selected models leave Copilot on Oct 19. Check client repos and CI agents for pinned model names.

watch.title: OpenAI cuts Cursor's model access — Nov 12
watch.body: Cursor becomes effectively xAI-only for frontier models after the cutoff. Client migration plans should be in motion now.

watch.title: White House AI oversight adviser appointment
watch.body: An adviser to oversee the new voluntary accord is due in the coming days; watch for any audit-reporting format vendors adopt.

watch.title: Muse for Small Business connector scopes
watch.body: Watch for Meta's published data-retention and training terms for connected business apps before advising SMB clients to enable it.

watch.title: Perplexity HP pre-install — October
watch.body: Perplexity ships preloaded on HP ZBook Ultra G3a from October; endpoint and acceptable-use policies may need an update.
